raw.content_en: The US Department of Commerce BIS rescinded the Biden-era firearms rule, restoring prior export control treatment for civilian firearms, ammunition, and parts. For China exporters of firearms-related and adjacent electronics (optics, RF modules, night-vision components), this shifts licensing thresholds and classification practice. Verify current USML/CCL jurisdiction, EAR classification, and license exception eligibility before shipment. Screen all parties against BIS Entity List, Denied Persons List, and OFAC SDN. Confirm FCC Part 15/18 conformity for any wireless or RF-enabled accessories, and map HTS lines against Section 301 lists to quantify additional duty exposure. Retain end-use and end-user statements and maintain a documented classification record.
raw.content_zh: 美国商务部BIS撤销了拜登时期的枪支规则，恢复了对民用枪支、弹药及零部件的原有出口管制待遇。对于中国出口枪支相关及邻近电子产品（光学、射频模块、夜视组件）的企业，许可门槛和分类实践发生变化。发运前须核实美国军品清单/商业管制清单管辖、EAR分类及许可例外适用性。对所有交易方进行BIS实体清单、被拒绝人员名单及OFAC SDN筛查。确认任何无线或射频配件的FCC Part 15/18合规，并将HTS编码对照301条款清单量化附加关税风险。保留最终用途和最终用户声明，并维护可追溯的分类记录。

checklist.desc: Determine whether items fall under USML or CCL; obtain ECCN or EAR99 determination and document the basis for the classification.
Confirm intentional radiators, modular approvals, and supplier FCC IDs for wireless or RF-enabled accessories before US entry.

checklist.task: BIS Entity List and restricted party screening
checklist.desc: Run BIS Entity List, Denied Persons List, Unverified List, and OFAC SDN screening; retain results and end-user/end-use statements.
Map the 10-digit HTS line against Section 301 lists and additional duties; document country of origin and value build-up.
Confirm eligibility for any license exception or obtain a BIS license; keep the authorization, classification, and screening records in the export file.
